responsibility: This file implements the RTL dead extension elimination pass (`ext_dce`), which removes zero/sign-extension work when the higher bits of the destination are never used. It performs a backward liveness analysis at subregister granularity by tracking four bit groups per register through RTL instructions, identifies extensions whose upper bits are dead, rewrites them into narrower `SUBREG`-based forms, and repairs `SUBREG_PROMOTED_VAR_P` state for affected pseudos. Its responsibility is late RTL dataflow-driven cleanup of redundant integer extension code before or around register allocation.
